# requirements.txt lists this app's direct dependencies, with loose-enough
# version pins that pip still has to resolve every transitive dependency
# (Starlette via FastAPI, h11 via Uvicorn/HTTPX, certifi, idna, etc.) on its
# own at install time - meaning two installs done months apart, or on two
# different machines, could silently end up with a different transitive
# tree, with no record here of what actually got installed or why it was
# safe. This file pins the complete, exact tree that requirements.txt
# resolved to when this file was generated, so a build is reproducible
# instead of dependent on whatever the latest compatible versions happen
# to be on the day it runs.
#
# Regenerate after changing requirements.txt:
#   python3 -m venv /tmp/lockenv && /tmp/lockenv/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt
#   /tmp/lockenv/bin/pip freeze > requirements-lock.txt
#
